scope: Behavior, ARIA, parts, events and state attributes of the web component in happy-dom (node:test), and the React renderer's server markup and client behavior. Rendered lengths and the indicator placement are covered by the browser geometry check and the React parity check; visual quality and screen-reader output are not certified.

checks.covers: preset and parts anatomy, tablist / tab / tabpanel ARIA, roving tabindex, arrow / Home / End keys (RTL, vertical, disabled skipped), activate-on-focus, change (cancelable, reason none), activation direction, indicator variables, no native form elements
resolveTabs: segmented composite list and 7u tabs, underline 8u tabs, 0.5u indicator, 1px track, 2u gap
React SSR: the same data-* as the web component on host, list, tabs, indicator and panels; the preset renders the composed parts; onValueChange details; keys and the indicator variables in the client

limitations: The indicator variables come from layout (getBoundingClientRect, snapped to 1/64 px); happy-dom reports zero boxes, so unit tests check that they are set and the browser geometry check checks their values.
React styling parity is checked in the browser: apps/studio/react-check.html ("fails": []).

Geometry review, manual items (2026-11-02, studio at u = 2, 3, the theme unit 4.5 and 6, B = 0 and 1, light and dark): growth (a long label keeps one line and widens its tab and the list; slots keep 6u; the indicator follows on resize), RTL (dir=rtl reverses the tab order and the horizontal arrow keys; both indicators follow the active tab), focus (the ring is inset by the thick border width, so it never changes a tab's size and stays within the segmented list), screenshots of the Disclosure family checked light and dark.
